summary: Iteration 41 — full backend + frontend verification of (1) Asana Index (public page, search, category chips, detail modal, admin CRUD + image upload) and (2) Bundle Upsell (program card, cart discount row, checkout total, server-side discount security). 18/18 pytest backend tests passed. All frontend flows passed: /asanas grid (12 seeded poses, images load), search 'camel' -> 1 result, empty state, clear, asana-cat-Backbend -> 3 Backbend cards, detail modal with 3 benefits + close, /library -> library-asana-link navigates to /asanas. Admin: sidebar admin-tab-asanas opens asanas-pane, cover UPLOAD -> preview renders, CREATE (13 rows) -> pose immediately visible on public /asanas, EDIT loads form + renames, DELETE removes it (back to 12). Bundle: card shows 2 thumbs, $117 struck / $99 / Save $18, bundle-add adds mat+journal and navigates to /cart with cart-discount-row '15% bundle discount −$17.55' and total $99.45; shipping form accepted and pay button label 'Pay $99.45' (no payment executed). Security re-verified: full set -> discount 17.55/total 99.45; mat only, journal only, and bogus bundle_program_id -> discount 0. Auth playbook spot-checks: bcrypt hash $2b$ (60 chars), httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None access_token cookie on login, brute-force lockout confirmed (5x401 then 429 on 6th using throwaway email). DB left clean: 12 asanas, 0 TEST_ poses, 4 pending test orders purged, cart emptied. No accounts registered, no payments completed.

issues: Displayed 'Save $18' / '$99' (Math.round of 17.55) does not match the real charge of $17.55 / $99.45 shown in cart & pay button. Confirmed expected per request, but consider showing $17.55/$99.45 (or 'from $99') to avoid a perceived price mismatch at checkout.
Content capped at max-w-4xl so the 3-column grid leaves large empty side gutters; mobile/tablet look correct. Cosmetic only.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic): align BundleUpsell displayed savings/price with the exact server figures ($17.55 / $99.45) or label as approximate.

OPTIONAL (minor): /api/admin/uploads hard-codes the storage path as '{APP_NAME}/retreats/...' (uploads.py:75), so asana cover photos are stored under a 'retreats' folder. Works, but the path is misleading — parameterize the folder.
critical_code_review_comments: orders.py bundle logic is correctly server-recomputed and requires related_ids.issubset(cart items) — tampering (partial set / fake program id) yields discount 0. Verified.
asanas.py: public list applies q-filtering in Python after fetching up to 1000 docs; fine at current scale but should move to a Mongo text/regex query if the library grows.
AsanasPane delete uses window.confirm (native dialog) — acceptable but inconsistent with the app's modal/toast style used elsewhere.

server.py CORS: allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=False. App auth uses Bearer tokens so this works, but the login endpoint also sets an httpOnly cookie that can never be sent cross-origin — either drop the cookie or set explicit CORS_ORIGINS with allow_credentials=True.
seed_data_creation: Temporary: 1 TEST_ asana (created then deleted), 4 pending orders (deleted from Mongo), 1 uploaded 78-byte test PNG left in uploads storage. 12 seeded poses intact.

Run /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iteration41.py afterwards to purge test orders and verify asana count == 12. Note: AsanasPane delete triggers window.confirm — register page.on('dialog', accept) in Playwright. Asana card images are lazy-loaded; wait ~3s before asserting naturalWidth. Do NOT register users or complete payments (live SMTP/Stripe).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found; only cosmetic rounding/display and upload-path naming observations.
